list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them. Names, descriptions and grades from the official list on Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles, frozen 2026-11-18. Guides are this entry's own words.
sources_note: Every trophy's name, description and grade come from the official list on Exophase (https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/) and PSNProfiles (https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). Where a trophy tracks a count, the count is PSN's, as PSNProfiles lists it. Guide advice is our own reading of the official descriptions; no place or step is pinned down until it is checked in the game.

trophies.guide: This is the reward for the other 54 — play the roadmap in order and it unlocks with the last one, no extra step needed. Keep the tracker open as you go so the final trophy is never a surprise: the checklist shows exactly what is left. Sources: Exophase (official list); the roadmap is our own plan built from the official descriptions.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so just play the story from the start and the trophy pops at the mission's end. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission. Chapter trophies unlock at the chapter's end, so there is nothing to hunt — keep following the story. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy it unlocks when the chapter's last mission ends, so play the story straight through. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The chapter's final mission ends the chapter and the trophy with it. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale — play the chapter through to its final mission. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. The story's ending unlocks this gold trophy; play the ending the game offers and see it through to the credits. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order, so keep playing the story and this pops when the mission ends. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission — reach it in the story and finish it. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission; play the story until it appears, then finish it. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission — it unlocks by finishing the mission, nothing else to prepare. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission set around the airport; finish it and the trophy pops. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission — play it to the end. Unmissable. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. This is the long one: it counts everything the game tracks — story, strangers, collectibles, activities and challenges. Use the tracker as your checklist and save it for last; the platinum waits on it. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (progress tracking); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — progress tracking

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and air time in vehicles — chain them in free roam after the story, when you can pick fast cars and open roads without a mission timer. The tracker counts to 250. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 250); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 250

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types — sample one of each rather than grinding one: racing, fishing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, meditation, drone racing, hunting and one more the game lists. Tick each off in the tracker as you try it. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 9 types); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 9 activity types

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit every shooting range and gold each challenge — steady aim beats speed, and you can retry any challenge until it is gold. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 42); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 42

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course once, then race to win — a win at all 14 locations is what counts, not a single win. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 14); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 14 locations

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty distinct race events, not twenty wins in one — work through the race list across Leonida and tick each different win off. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 20); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 20

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him — the trophy is the win, not the catch count. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade game and play it to its end — one finished game is enough. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand ends with this — play his missions in order until the last one is done. Unmissable once you start his strand. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the state — visit each and meditate there; the tracker counts to 18. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 18); our own advice from the official description.

sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks for one specific animal — track it, take it down, and bring it back to him. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.

sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect full sets, and 3 finished sets pop the silver. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 3 sets); our own advice from the official description.

sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK photo spots are spread across the map — snap 100 of them; the tracker counts to 100. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 100); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 100

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side goals — finish any 50 across all types; the counter in the tracker keeps the running total. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 50); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 50

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear — do it in free roam where you control the chase. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them — plan the route first so the three are close together. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts — drive anything you have not driven before; the tracker counts to 100. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 100); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 100

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop 5 before it ends — a busy fight is the right moment. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is one of the two missable trophies in this guide: leave the airport by an unscheduled route — a runway or a gap in the fence, not the terminal — and do it while the chance is in front of you, because the moment may not come back. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own reading of the official description.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks — get into the thick of it with them around, survive the heat, and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses — and get out clean; if you are spotted, leave and try again. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault jobs, each finished with a clean escape — the count is what matters, so any five will do. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 5); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 5

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cargo and get away clean. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. All 52 areas of the state count — drive every road and visit every corner until the map is filled in. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 52 areas); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 52 areas

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Nine gangs, one operation each — hit one illegal operation per gang and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 9 gangs); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment, available any time in free roam. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is the second missable trophy in this guide: the showroom escape is a one-shot scripted moment — drive out through the glass and the front, and do it the first time the game gives you the chance. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own reading of the official description.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through — one visit is enough. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A partner moment that lands with the crowd — play the partner content and it comes. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks 500 choices — keep making them as you play; the count climbs across the whole game. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 500); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 500

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail once, then succeed on the retry — the trophy is for the comeback, not the first try. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — go looking for the odd, and the trophy pops when you find it. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock someone down — a drive-by with your hands, not a gun. Sources: Exophase (official list); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills to your contacts over time — the total is what counts, so launder steadily and the trophy pops at $250,000. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: $250,000); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: $250,000

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shopping counts across every shop — spend $100,000 in total and it pops. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: $100,000); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: $100,000

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garages around Leonida — save the money for them, then buy them one by one. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 8); our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — PSN count: 8

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten different vehicles in the app — any ten you drive will do. Sources: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 10); our own advice from the official description.
